content: Mu Tesalonika
Cwale aba ana kubita mu Amfipolisi ni mu Apoloniya, sebeli aiya mu Tesalonika omo kuna kwikala endoo no milapelo no Majuda.
Paulusi mu mukwa waye sebeli oingena kwa onyene, mi mu tisunda taatu, yo kanana noo okutunda mu man̄olo
ni kwataluseta ni kwamonisa nji kame kuna kufanena Kilesite oku yupisiwa okukola ni kwinguka kwaafu, ni kwamba nji, “Woyo Jesu nineeyi mu kwamba kwaanyi eyaye, yokame Kilesite.”
Cwale anjili mukaci koo sebeli asusuezwa, nuukuwana ni Paulusi ni Sailasi bamweya naa nokupula no Mangelike mane naakati no kupula ao akutekiwa.

Kono aendisi no Majuda kame ana kwafelanga omuna, mi sebeli ashimba aafokoli anjili anatoliwa, ni kwaawaneka okwaatenda esitopa, ni kubeeka omulenen̄i mukaci, okutinguluka endoo ya Njasoni, okwaasaela nji aalite kwaanu.
Cwale aba na kuulwa okwawana, sebeli akokela Njasoni naanjili aasikupumena balubala no abusisi no mulenen̄i alemine okukuwa nji, “Alume awo ana liti outata mu litunga, kame aneyi ni kuno,
mi Njasoni naatambula, mi onje kame alwisa emilao ya Sizale aamba nji kame kuli omunjili Ombumu yonyene Jesu.”
Cwale aanu naabusisi no mulenen̄i sebeli ahakanyeha aba ana kuyupa eyi.
Cwale aba ana kushimba amali kwa Josani ni kwaanjili, sebeli aalesela nuukutela.
Mu Beliya
Ababo aasikupumena sebeli afundula Paulusi ni Sailasi ousiku okuta ku Beliya, mi aba ana kukeela sebeli aingena mu ndoo no milapelo no Majuda.

Cwale aendisi no Majuda aa kame ana kwikala ni micima no kuwaba okubita awo na mu Tesalonika, kakuli kame ana tambula eliywi mu kutukufalelwa, ni kusaisisa mu man̄olo mu liywaa ni liywaa okumona nji einu eyi moikalele.
Ano kupula mwaonyene sebeli apumena, naakati no kukutekeha no Mangelike naalume ngeeso.
Kono cwale aendisi no Majuda na mu Tesalonika aba ana kuyupa nji eliywi lya Nyambe kame lyambiwa kwa Paulusi mu Beliya, sebeli aiya mo mu kufilikanya esicaba.
Cwale aasikupumena ababo sebeli afundula Paulusi, okumutwala ku liwate, kono Sailasi ni Timoteya sebeli asiyalamo.
Awo ana sindeketa Paulusi sebeli akakeela ku Atenesisi, abaana kuuka sebeli aiya ni titaelo okutunda kwa Paulusi nji, Sailasi ni Timoteya ate kwa yonyene muwangu mi ababo sebeli afunduka.
Mu Atenesisi
Ababo Paulusi yosaatatelele mu Atenesi, sebeli otina aba ana kumona nji omulenen̄i kame wiyalile eifekiso no milimu.
Cwale sebeli okanana ni Majuda mu ndoo no milapelo naanu awo acila Nyambe, sebeli otenda ngeso muliywaa ni liywaa ku munu yonje woyo ona kuwaninga mu musika.

Cwale a si Epikulini ni sitoiki filosofi sebeli aambola naye. Mi anjili sebeli aamba nji, “Osibuwabuwi uyu iikene aamba?” Anjili sebeli aamba nji, “Kame amonahala kanyi omukutazi no milimu indina.” kakuli kame ana kwaataluseta ya Jesu neyi no kwinguka kwaafu.
Cwale sebeli amushimba, okuta naye ku Aleopangasi ni kwamba nji, “Kame tusinga okulimuka eyi tuto no ubya eyi wamba iikene italusa?
Kakuli nuliti eyambo no kwatwaelwa mu matwi etu, cwale kame tusinga okulimuka eyi italusa.”
Cwale Amaatenesi onje naanu andina ao ayoyanga mo kaasikutenda esindina konji okwamba simba okuyupa eyi no ubya.
Cwale Paulusi sebeli oimana bakaci nwa Aleopangasi ni kwamba nji, “Anyi alume no Atenesi, kame ni lemuhile nji mu ndila yonje kame muli ni tumelo.

Kakuli aba ninabiti kame nina mono outokwa wetu noo ku lapela, sebeli ni wana ealetale aba ku n̄olilwe nji, ‘Kwa Nyambe no kwalimukiwa.’ Iikene cwale aba mu lapelela einu no kwalimukiwa, eyi yanamba kwaanyi.
Nyambe ona ku tenda elitunga niinu yonje ilimo, bakutenda Ombumu no liwilu ni litunga, ka yoyo mu tikeleke ti yakilwe ni maoko nwaanu.
Simba kame asebelezwa ni maoko nwaanu, kanyi nji kame asaela esinjili, kakuli yonyene kame aba aanu onje ouplo ni kooyela ni inu yonje.
Cwale kame ana kutenda mumweya mu matunga onje nwaanu oku yoya ba lubala no litunga longe, yokame ona lukisa etinako ni miseto no aanu omo ayayo.
Cwale nji kame afanena okusaela Nyambe, mu kuyambuta nji mba mubabatele ni ku muwana, mi yonyene kayoyo oku no kuleba naaci.
kakuli mwa yonyene kame,
Sokame anaamba asikuloka anjili nji,
Cwale aba tuli ana a Nyambe, ka tulukele oku yambuta nji Nyambe mba feke kanyi gauda, simba esilibela, simba eliwee, eili eyi imanena esifekiso no mihupulo no munu.
Mu nako na kunyima Nyambe kame ana kwaliketanga aanu feela, kono bano kame alaela aanu onje okwaali nji abake.
Kakuli na kubeeka eliywaa elyo saatule elitunga mu niti mu mulume woyo ana kuketa, mi mweesi nabi aanu onje mu kumwingula kwaafu!”
Cwale aba na kuyupa eyi no kwinguka kwaafu, anjili sebeli asheka kono anjili sebeli aamba nji, “Kame satu kuyupe kame wamba ba tuto eyi.”
Cwale Paulusi ababo sebeli waasiya.
Kono aanu anjili sebeli akon̄a ni ku pumena, mwaonyene Denisi no Aleopangasi ni mukati no litina lya Damalisi naanjili aanu.
